items.q: What is the best time to visit Morocco?
items.a: Spring (March–May) and Autumn (September–November) offer the most comfortable temperatures across all regions. Summer is ideal for the coast; winter for the Sahara and southern deserts.

items.q: Do I need a visa to visit Morocco?
items.a: Most Western passport holders (USA, EU, UK, Canada, Australia) can enter Morocco visa-free for up to 90 days. Always verify with the Moroccan embassy in your country.
Morocco uses the Moroccan Dirham (MAD). It is not freely convertible outside Morocco, so exchange money after arrival. ATMs are widely available in cities.
Morocco is generally safe for tourists. The main risks are petty theft in medinas and tourist scams. Stick to verified booking platforms and vetted tour operators.
Imourig charges operators 10% of the confirmed booking value, invoiced monthly. Travelers pay operators directly — Imourig does not handle payments.
